title: Cap consecutive runs while resetting state between runs
goal: Repair cap_runs(items, limit). items is a list of values with ordinary scalar-valued Python equality (including None, booleans, numbers, strings and lists); limit is an integer. Return a new list retaining the first at most limit items of EACH maximal consecutive run of equal values, in their original order and with their original values. Equality is Python ==, so False and 0 belong to the same consecutive run, and True and 1 do too. A later run of a previously encountered value has a fresh allowance. Raise ValueError when limit < 0, even for empty items. limit == 0 returns []; empty input returns [] for any nonnegative limit. Never modify the input list or its elements. Preserve the function signature.
constraints: Do not add files, dependencies, or modify tests.
Keep cap_runs and its signature unchanged.
